anomalies.expected: LM1117-5.0 requires an output capacitor of at least 10uF (with ESR 0.1-10 ohm) for stability; C1 should be 10uF or larger.
anomalies.impact: The regulator may oscillate or be unstable, causing the +5V rail to be noisy or out of regulation, potentially affecting the MCUs and other 5V circuitry.

anomalies.observed: Two ATtiny microcontrollers (U1 ATtiny45-20P DIP-8 and U2 ATtiny13V-10S SOIC-8) are both present in the netlist and their I/O pins are connected in parallel on the same nets.
anomalies.expected: Only one ATtiny should be populated, or the two should be isolated to prevent bus contention.
anomalies.impact: If both are populated, they will drive the same I/O lines, causing contention, possible damage, and incorrect operation.
